newsitem.title: USA: Corning's DAMON is fined in fraud case.
newsitem.headline: Corning's DAMON is fined in fraud case.

text.p: Corning Inc's DAMON Clinic Laboratories has agreed to plead guilty to conspiracy to defaud Medicare and the government and will pay $119 million in fines and penalties, a federal prosecutor said on Wednesday.
The plea agreement, which represents treble damages, must be approved by a judge, the U.S. Attorney for Massachusetts, Donald Stern, said in a statement.
The settlement represents $35.3 million in criminal fines and $83.7 million in civil liabilities. The civil settlement resolves allegations that DAMON submitted false claims to Medicare, Stern said.
Whistleblowers sparked the initial probe by federal officials, and the whistleblowers will receive a portion of the government's share of the civil amount.
